text:
sasha: heads-up — PR opened: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428> adds SDK snippet and a migration guide. netlify preview shows some example images 404ing. want a quick reviewer + merge tonight if we can fix the preview :eyes:
oliver: i can take a look in 10m. can you paste the netlify failure logs?
jen: CI linkcheck is failing on two anchors and the asset 404, stacktrace shows mkdocs can't find /assets/examples/*.png
netlify-bot: Build failed — 1 error, 2 warnings. Error: 404 Not Found: /assets/examples/llm-workflow.png at /home/netlify/build/site/index.html
anita: my hunch: the PR moves example images into docs/static/examples but the mkdocs config still references /assets. quick fix is to add a redirect or update the path in the MD.
liam: is this something we can verify locally quickly? i usually do: `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt` then `mkdocs build --clean` and `mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000` to preview the same artifact Netlify builds.
sasha: thanks — adding local steps to the PR description could help reviewers. also thinking: can we use a temporary Vercel preview for faster turnaround? Netlify queue is long tonight.
oliver: quick patch idea — edit the md to reference `![](/static/examples/llm-workflow.png)` instead of `/assets/...`. or add this to mkdocs.yml:```markdown
extra:
  base_path: "/assets"
```
jen: small nit — prefer not to introduce new mkdocs hacks. simpler to update the image paths in the PR. i'll do that and re-run the build.
docs-ci: re-run requested by jen on PR #428 — build queued (attempt 2).
netlify-bot: Deploy preview updated — build succeeded. Two warnings from linkcheck about anchor `#sdk-init` not found.
sasha: great — can someone quick-review the migration guide wording? specifically the section that suggests switching token strategies.
anita: i'll do the content pass. note: add a tiny code snippet for the Python SDK init: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ["REDWOOD_API_KEY"], region="us-east-1")
```
liam: verified locally that `mkdocs build` yields no missing assets after path change. also added a small note to PR: how to run local preview (requirements + mkdocs serve) and how to flush the netlify cache if needed.
oliver: LGTM from me. leaving a :shipit: and assigning merge window to 18:30 PT.
sasha: thanks everyone. jen — can you merge at 18:30 if green? I'll cut a follow-up to update the example repo paths tomorrow.
jen: yep will merge if green. leaving the CI gate open until then. :thumbsup:
